definition: Not normal, often in a worrying way.
examples: The test showed abnormal results.
This cold weather is abnormal for June.
He has an abnormal heartbeat.

spanish.definition: Que no es normal, a menudo de forma preocupante.

definition: A strip of cloth used to cover a cut.
examples: The nurse put a bandage on my arm.
He had a bandage around his head.
Change the bandage every day.

spanish.definition: Tira de tela usada para cubrir una herida.

definition: To produce something.
examples: The wind turbines generate electricity.
The event generated a lot of money.
This app generates a new password for you.

spanish.definition: Producir algo.

definition: A unit of weight equal to 1,000 grams.
examples: I bought a kilo of rice.
He lost five kilos.
The bag weighs ten kilos.

spanish.definition: Unidad de peso igual a 1,000 gramos.

definition: Easy to know before it happens.
examples: The end of the movie was predictable.
He's so predictable.
The weather here is very predictable.

spanish.definition: Fácil de saber antes de que pase.

definition: The act of getting bigger.
examples: The company is planning an expansion.
The airport expansion will take five years.
We've seen a rapid expansion of the city.

spanish.definition: Acto de hacerse más grande.

definition: No longer existing.
examples: Dinosaurs are extinct.
Many animals may become extinct.
This bird went extinct 100 years ago.

spanish.definition: Que ya no existe.

definition: Believing that people only care about themselves.
examples: He has a cynical view of politics.
Don't be so cynical.
She became cynical after the divorce.

spanish.definition: Que cree que a la gente solo le importa ella misma.

definition: Ideas or information you give to help.
examples: Thanks for your input.
We need more input from the team.
The computer needs your input to continue.

spanish.definition: Ideas o información que das para ayudar.

definition: To cut something with a long, quick movement; the symbol /.
examples: Someone slashed my tires.
The store slashed its prices.
Type a slash between the two words.

spanish.definition: Cortar algo con un movimiento largo y rápido; el símbolo /.

definition: To say something is bigger or better than it really is.
examples: Don't exaggerate. It wasn't that bad.
He exaggerated the size of the fish.
She's always exaggerating.

spanish.definition: Decir que algo es más grande o mejor de lo que es.

definition: A man whose job is to stop fires.
examples: My son wants to be a fireman.
A fireman saved the cat.
The fireman climbed the ladder.

spanish.definition: Hombre cuyo trabajo es apagar incendios.

definition: A sharp point on a plant.
examples: Be careful of the thorns on the roses.
A thorn cut my finger.
This bush is full of thorns.

spanish.definition: Punta afilada en una planta.

definition: A time of physical exercise.
examples: I do a short workout every morning.
That was a hard workout.
She listens to music during her workout.

spanish.definition: Tiempo de ejercicio físico.

definition: Empty; not being used.
examples: The apartment has been vacant for months.
There's a vacant lot next door.
He gave me a vacant look.

spanish.definition: Vacío; que no se está usando.

definition: The end of a romantic relationship.
examples: She's sad after the breakup.
They had a difficult breakup.
He wrote a song about their breakup.

spanish.definition: Fin de una relación romántica.

definition: Full of bright colors.
examples: She wore a colorful dress.
The market is full of colorful fruit.
They live in a very colorful neighborhood.

spanish.definition: Lleno de colores vivos.

definition: A sloping road or surface.
examples: The building has a wheelchair ramp.
Take the next exit ramp.
He rolled the box up the ramp.

spanish.definition: Camino o superficie inclinada.

definition: A wide city street, often with trees.
examples: We walked down Sunset Boulevard.
The boulevard is lined with palm trees.
The hotel is on the main boulevard.

spanish.definition: Calle ancha de la ciudad, a menudo con árboles.

definition: To get something.
examples: The museum acquired a new painting.
She acquired a taste for coffee.
They're acquiring a smaller company.

spanish.definition: Obtener algo.

definition: To give your time or effort to something.
examples: She dedicated her life to helping others.
I dedicate this song to my mother.
He's dedicating more time to his family.

spanish.definition: Dar tu tiempo o esfuerzo a algo.

definition: The first public appearance of someone.
examples: The singer made her debut at sixteen.
It's his debut album.
She played well in her debut.

spanish.definition: Primera aparición pública de alguien.

definition: To fill a space or time; to take control of a place.
examples: The sofa occupies half the room.
The army occupied the city.
Video games keep the kids occupied.

spanish.definition: Llenar un espacio o tiempo; tomar el control de un lugar.

definition: The quality of being clear.
examples: I admire the clarity of her writing.
The photo has great clarity.
We need more clarity on this.

spanish.definition: Cualidad de ser claro.

definition: A person who writes opinions about books or movies; a person who says something is bad.
examples: The movie critic loved the film.
She's a food critic for the newspaper.
The president's critics are getting louder.

spanish.definition: Persona que escribe opiniones sobre libros o películas; persona que dice que algo es malo.

definition: Covered with oil or fat.
examples: I don't like greasy food.
His hair looks greasy.
These fries are too greasy.

spanish.definition: Cubierto de aceite o grasa.

definition: The study of the structure of the body.
examples: She's taking an anatomy class.
Medical students study human anatomy.
He has a good knowledge of anatomy.

spanish.definition: Estudio de la estructura del cuerpo.

definition: An unfair opinion about a group of people.
examples: There's still a lot of racial prejudice.
We must fight prejudice.
She faced prejudice at work.

spanish.definition: Opinión injusta sobre un grupo de personas.

definition: The first public showing of a movie or a play.
examples: The stars came to the movie premiere.
The show's premiere is in September.
We got tickets to the premiere.

spanish.definition: Primera función pública de una película o una obra.

definition: A person who makes sure players follow the rules.
examples: The referee blew his whistle.
The fans yelled at the referee.
She's a soccer referee.

spanish.definition: Persona que se asegura de que los jugadores sigan las reglas.

definition: A device that notices heat, light, or movement.
examples: The lights have a motion sensor.
A sensor in the car warned me.
The door has a sensor that opens it.

spanish.definition: Aparato que nota el calor, la luz o el movimiento.

definition: A woman who works at home and takes care of her family.
examples: My mother was a housewife.
She's a housewife with three kids.
She stayed home as a housewife for many years.

spanish.definition: Mujer que trabaja en casa y cuida a su familia.

definition: The shape of an old animal or plant preserved in rock.
examples: We found a fossil on the beach.
Scientists study dinosaur fossils.
This fossil is millions of years old.

spanish.definition: Forma de un animal o planta antiguos conservada en la roca.

definition: To put something in liquid for a time; to make something very wet.
examples: Soak the beans overnight.
The rain soaked my clothes.
She's soaking in a hot bath.

spanish.definition: Poner algo en un líquido por un tiempo; dejar algo muy mojado.

definition: Connected to learning.
examples: This is a very educational show.
We bought some educational games.
She has an excellent educational background.

spanish.definition: Relacionado con el aprendizaje.

definition: The act of saying no to someone or something.
examples: I got another rejection letter today.
He's afraid of rejection.
Rejection is hard for a writer.

spanish.definition: Acto de decirle que no a alguien o algo.

definition: To hold something tightly; the part of a car you press to change gears.
examples: She clutched her bag.
He clutched his chest in pain.
Press the clutch and change gears.

spanish.definition: Sostener algo con fuerza; parte del carro que presionas para cambiar de marcha.

definition: Dark or sad.
examples: It was a cold, gloomy day.
Why do you look so gloomy?
The news was gloomy.

spanish.definition: Oscuro o triste.

definition: A tall building with a strong light that guides ships.
examples: We climbed the old lighthouse.
The lighthouse warns ships about the rocks.
There's a lighthouse at the end of the beach.

spanish.definition: Edificio alto con una luz fuerte que guía a los barcos.

definition: Lasting a long time, used for illness or problems.
examples: He suffers from chronic back pain.
Diabetes is a chronic disease.
The city has a chronic shortage of nurses.

spanish.definition: Que dura mucho tiempo, usado para enfermedades o problemas.

definition: To keep something going; to suffer an injury.
examples: We can't sustain this level of spending.
He sustained a head injury.
Food sustains the body.

spanish.definition: Mantener algo en marcha; sufrir una lesión.

definition: To say strongly that something is wrong.
examples: The president condemned the attack.
Everyone condemned his behavior.
She was condemned to life in prison.

spanish.definition: Decir con fuerza que algo está mal.

definition: Without wires.
examples: I bought wireless headphones.
The hotel has wireless internet.
He uses a wireless mouse.

spanish.definition: Sin cables.

definition: A short pole for moving a small boat; to move a boat with this pole.
examples: He lost his paddle in the river.
We paddled across the lake.
She's paddling the canoe alone.

spanish.definition: Palo corto para mover un bote pequeño; mover un bote con este palo.

definition: To feel a need to scratch your skin.
examples: My nose itches.
The bite is itching a lot.
I have an itch on my back.

spanish.definition: Sentir la necesidad de rascarse la piel.

definition: One of the foods used to make a dish.
examples: What are the ingredients in this soup?
Fresh ingredients make better food.
Check the ingredients on the box.

spanish.definition: Uno de los alimentos usados para hacer un plato.

definition: The act of taking money from a bank; the act of leaving.
examples: I made a withdrawal from the bank.
The army began its withdrawal.
He's going through drug withdrawal.

spanish.definition: Acto de sacar dinero de un banco; acto de irse.

definition: Thinking about other people's feelings.
examples: He's a very considerate neighbor.
It was considerate of you to call.
Please be more considerate of others.

spanish.definition: Que piensa en los sentimientos de otros.

definition: To make something easier to understand.
examples: Can you clarify what you mean?
She clarified the rules for us.
He's clarifying his statement.

spanish.definition: Hacer que algo sea más fácil de entender.

definition: Acting younger than your age.
examples: He's so immature.
That was an immature thing to do.
She's still too immature for this job.

spanish.definition: Que actúa como alguien más joven.

definition: To join one thing to another.
examples: I attached the photo to the email.
She attached a note to the box.
He's very attached to his dog.

spanish.definition: Unir una cosa a otra.

definition: A surface that goes up or down.
examples: We skied down the slope.
The house is on a steep slope.
There's a gentle slope behind the school.

spanish.definition: Superficie que sube o baja.

definition: Knowledge that something exists or is important.
examples: We need to raise awareness of this disease.
There's a growing awareness of the problem.
Public awareness is key.

spanish.definition: Conocimiento de que algo existe o es importante.

definition: A thick, soft mix.
examples: Mix the flour and water into a paste.
She added tomato paste to the sauce.
Use this paste to stick the paper to the wall.

spanish.definition: Mezcla espesa y suave.

definition: A time when the sun or moon is hidden by another space object.
examples: We watched the solar eclipse.
There's a lunar eclipse tonight.
You shouldn't look at an eclipse without special glasses.

spanish.definition: Momento en que el sol o la luna quedan ocultos por otro astro.

definition: To force a rule or a cost on someone.
examples: The city imposed a new tax.
I don't want to impose on you.
They're imposing strict rules.

spanish.definition: Obligar a alguien a aceptar una regla o un costo.

definition: Money that a company or a government gets.
examples: The company's revenue grew by 10 percent.
Tourism brings in a lot of revenue.
Tax revenue is down this year.

spanish.definition: Dinero que recibe una empresa o un gobierno.

definition: A small hollow in a surface after a hit.
examples: There's a dent in my car door.
The ball left a dent in the wall.
He fixed the dent himself.

spanish.definition: Hundimiento pequeño en una superficie después de un golpe.

definition: A shape that goes around and around.
examples: We climbed a spiral staircase.
Smoke rose in a spiral.
She drew a spiral on her notebook.

spanish.definition: Forma que da vueltas y vueltas.

definition: A six-point score in football.
examples: He scored a touchdown in the last minute.
The crowd went crazy after the touchdown.
They won with a late touchdown.

spanish.definition: Anotación de seis puntos en fútbol americano.

definition: A change that fixes a mistake.
examples: The teacher made some corrections on my paper.
The newspaper printed a correction.
I have one small correction.

spanish.definition: Cambio que arregla un error.

definition: A long piece of music for an orchestra.
examples: We heard a Beethoven symphony.
She plays in the city symphony.
He wrote nine symphonies.

spanish.definition: Pieza larga de música para orquesta.

definition: Very upsetting and leaving a lasting effect.
examples: The accident was a traumatic experience.
The divorce was traumatic for the kids.
He doesn't talk about that traumatic day.

spanish.definition: Muy perturbador y con un efecto duradero.

definition: Happening often.
examples: He makes frequent trips to New York.
She has frequent headaches.
I'm a frequent visitor to this park.

spanish.definition: Que pasa a menudo.

definition: A discussion to reach an agreement.
examples: The negotiations lasted all week.
He's good at salary negotiation.
They're in negotiation with the union.

spanish.definition: Discusión para llegar a un acuerdo.

definition: Continuing to try; lasting a long time.
examples: She's very persistent.
I have a persistent cough.
The persistent rain ruined the weekend.

spanish.definition: Que sigue intentando; que dura mucho tiempo.

definition: Bad behavior, usually by children, that isn't serious.
examples: The boys are always getting into mischief.
He had a look of mischief in his eyes.
Keep your little brother out of mischief.

spanish.definition: Mal comportamiento, por lo general de niños, que no es grave.

definition: The man who is married to your mother but isn't your father.
examples: My stepfather taught me to drive.
He lives with his mom and stepfather.
She gets along well with her stepfather.

spanish.definition: Hombre casado con tu madre que no es tu padre.

definition: Caused by a virus; spreading very fast online.
examples: The video went viral.
He has a viral infection.
That viral photo has millions of likes.

spanish.definition: Causado por un virus; que se propaga muy rápido por internet.

definition: Very strong anger.
examples: The decision caused public outrage.
It's an outrage!
People reacted with outrage.

spanish.definition: Rabia muy fuerte.

definition: Able to bend or to change easily.
examples: This plastic is very flexible.
I have a flexible schedule.
Yoga makes you more flexible.

spanish.definition: Que se puede doblar o cambiar con facilidad.

definition: Held and not free; a person who is held.
examples: The soldiers were held captive.
The captives were released yesterday.
Captive animals need a lot of space.

spanish.definition: Retenido y sin libertad; persona retenida.

definition: The quality of being believed and trusted.
examples: The scandal hurt his credibility.
The witness has no credibility.
The newspaper lost its credibility.

spanish.definition: Cualidad de ser creído y de confianza.

definition: Causing a lot of disagreement.
examples: It's a very controversial law.
He made a controversial statement.
Her new book is controversial.

spanish.definition: Que causa mucho desacuerdo.

definition: Very excited and interested.
examples: She's enthusiastic about her new job.
The crowd was very enthusiastic.
He isn't enthusiastic about the idea.

spanish.definition: Muy emocionado e interesado.

definition: The stopper in a wine bottle.
examples: He pulled the cork out of the bottle.
The cork fell into the wine.
She collects wine corks.

spanish.definition: Tapón de una botella de vino.

definition: A small round fruit that grows in bunches.
examples: I'd like some red grapes.
Wine is made from grapes.
These grapes are very sweet.

spanish.definition: Fruta pequeña y redonda que crece en racimos.

definition: Not often.
examples: He seldom goes out at night.
We seldom eat meat.
She seldom talks about her past.

spanish.definition: No muy a menudo.

definition: Not caring about other people's feelings.
examples: That was an insensitive comment.
How can you be so insensitive?
He's insensitive to her needs.

spanish.definition: Que no se preocupa por los sentimientos de otros.

definition: To make something begin.
examples: She always initiates the conversation.
The city initiated a new program.
Who's initiating the meeting?

spanish.definition: Hacer que algo empiece.

definition: The way something is made of parts; a piece of music or writing.
examples: We studied the composition of soil.
The kids wrote a composition about summer.
This piano composition is beautiful.

spanish.definition: Manera en que algo está hecho de partes; pieza de música o escritura.

definition: A tool for turning nuts and bolts.
examples: Hand me the wrench, please.
He tightened it with a wrench.
I need a bigger wrench.

spanish.definition: Herramienta para girar tuercas y pernos.

definition: A small mistake or weakness.
examples: There's a flaw in your plan.
Everyone has flaws.
This glass has a small flaw.

spanish.definition: Error o debilidad pequeña.

definition: The space where a door opens.
examples: He stood in the doorway.
She waited in the doorway of the store.
The doorway is too narrow for the sofa.

spanish.definition: Espacio donde se abre una puerta.

definition: On purpose.
examples: He didn't do it intentionally.
She intentionally left the door open.
I would never hurt you intentionally.

spanish.definition: A propósito.

definition: A field of grass and flowers.
examples: Cows were eating in the meadow.
We had a picnic in the meadow.
The meadow is full of yellow flowers.

spanish.definition: Campo de hierba y flores.

definition: Very poor; wanting too much attention.
examples: We gave food to needy families.
He's a very needy boyfriend.
The church helps the needy.

spanish.definition: Muy pobre; que quiere demasiada atención.

definition: The way you explain or understand something.
examples: That's one interpretation of the law.
Her interpretation of the song is beautiful.
The poem is open to interpretation.

spanish.definition: Manera en que explicas o entiendes algo.

definition: Not finished or missing parts.
examples: Your homework is incomplete.
The form is incomplete.
The report gives an incomplete picture.

spanish.definition: Sin terminar o con partes que faltan.

definition: A hard choice between two things.
examples: I have a dilemma: stay or go?
She's facing a moral dilemma.
We're in a real dilemma about the house.

spanish.definition: Elección difícil entre dos cosas.

definition: Important and famous; easy to see.
examples: He's a prominent lawyer.
She has a prominent place in the story.
The tower is the most prominent building in town.

spanish.definition: Importante y famoso; fácil de ver.

definition: A person who cuts and styles hair.
examples: I have an appointment with my hairdresser.
My hairdresser cut it too short.
She works as a hairdresser.

spanish.definition: Persona que corta y arregla el pelo.

definition: To have the right skills or to meet the conditions for something.
examples: The team qualified for the World Cup.
Do I qualify for a discount?
She's qualifying as a nurse this year.

spanish.definition: Tener las habilidades correctas o cumplir las condiciones para algo.

definition: A heavy fuel used in trucks and some cars.
examples: This truck runs on diesel.
Diesel is cheaper here.
I put diesel in my car by mistake.

spanish.definition: Combustible pesado que usan los camiones y algunos carros.

definition: The practice of sitting quietly to relax your mind.
examples: I do ten minutes of meditation every morning.
Meditation helps me sleep.
She teaches meditation at the gym.

spanish.definition: Práctica de sentarse en silencio para relajar la mente.

definition: A large size or amount; most of something.
examples: We buy rice in bulk.
The bulk of my money goes to rent.
He spends the bulk of his time at work.

spanish.definition: Tamaño o cantidad grande; la mayor parte de algo.

definition: A set of stairs in a building.
examples: The house has a beautiful wooden staircase.
She walked down the staircase.
There's a spiral staircase in the tower.

spanish.definition: Conjunto de escalones en un edificio.

definition: Needing someone or something to live or succeed.
examples: The kids are dependent on their parents.
He's dependent on his medication.
The town is dependent on tourism.

spanish.definition: Que necesita a alguien o algo para vivir o tener éxito.

definition: Believing that something good will happen.
examples: I'm hopeful that we'll win.
She's hopeful about the future.
The doctors are hopeful.

spanish.definition: Que cree que algo bueno va a pasar.

definition: A person who takes payment in a store.
examples: Pay the cashier at the front.
She works as a cashier at the supermarket.
The cashier gave me the wrong change.

spanish.definition: Persona que recibe el pago en una tienda.
